t0292-01.gloss: A hairdresser records matching residue on field workers before a road closure.
t0292-01.rival_reading: The matching smell and road closure could mark exposure discovered during an emergency response rather than a farm program that caused it.

t0292-02.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
t0292-02.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
